parsed.name: BioShake微孔板恒温振荡器
parsed.description: 台式微孔板加热振荡装置，用于对PCR板、微孔板等样品进行可控温度下的混匀。支持设定振荡转速、加速度/减速度，具备板夹锁定功能以稳定夹持样品板，并可进行温度设定与保持（部分型号支持主动冷却）。适用于分子生物学、酶标反应和样品预处理等实验流程及实验室自动化集成。
parsed.description_en: A benchtop microplate heater-shaker for mixing samples in PCR plates and microplates under controlled temperature. It supports setting shaking speed with acceleration/deceleration, features a plate-locking clamp for secure holding, and provides temperature setpoint control (with active cooling on some models). Ideal for molecular biology, assay incubation, and sample preparation, including lab automation workflows.
